set_aside.subject: R0-89 backup storage and encryption boundary
set_aside.text: Registry makes daily encrypted backups and checks each one (State 2).
set_aside.question: Where are the backups stored, which actor or external system can access them, and who holds and manages the encryption key, which is not among the secrets currently named by State 0?
options: Backups remain on the production host and use an owner-managed key
Backups are stored on an owner-controlled external system with an owner-managed key
A backup provider stores them and manages or participates in key management
set_aside.default_guess: Store encrypted backups off-host on an owner-controlled system, with the encryption key supplied and controlled by the owner outside Registry.

set_aside.subject: R0-89 scheduled backup action
set_aside.text: Registry makes daily encrypted backups and checks each one (State 2).
set_aside.question: What observable result shows that a daily backup was created and passed its check, and what does Registry do or expose when creation, encryption, storage or checking fails?
options: Record success and failure in owner-visible operational status
Emit diagnostics only, with external monitoring responsible for observation
Record only failures and continue serving
Refuse or stop serving after a backup failure
set_aside.default_guess: Continue serving, expose owner-visible backup status, and emit a non-personal diagnostic on failure.

set_aside.subject: R0-89 recovery-point data loss
set_aside.text: every change after it is lost, the audit entries with it
set_aside.question: Which changes are lost on restoration: changes made after the restored backup was taken, changes made after the store was lost, or some other interval?
options: All changes committed after the restored backup was taken
Only changes occurring after detection of the store loss
Changes after a separately recorded recovery point
set_aside.default_guess: All changes committed after the restored backup was taken are lost, including their audit entries.
